capabilities: Toggle sharing per note via a Boolean property
Copy shared notes and their embedded non-Markdown attachments to a destination folder
Sync shared copies when notes or known attachments change
Reconcile and initialize sharing toggles across the vault
Move managed copies to the OS trash when sharing is switched off
disambiguation: Not a web-publishing or share-link tool; it copies files to a local destination folder that an external AI agent uses as its workspace.
extras: Desktop-only; makes no network requests, needs no account, and has no telemetry. The README warns it is an allowlist, not a sandbox, and that a sandboxed agent can modify anything mounted into it; the full Docker/Terminal setup is documented elsewhere.
problem: Obsidian gives no built-in way to expose only chosen notes and attachments to an external AI tool without risking the rest of a private vault.

relations.evidence: For the complete Obsidian, Docker Sandbox and Terminal workflow, see Full setup.

requires.name: AI agent or external tool using the destination folder as its workspace (Docker for the sandbox workflow)

summary: Allowlist-based exporter that copies notes flagged with a Boolean property, plus their embedded attachments, to a folder workspace for AI agents.
